cases.title: AC-15 [ED-06, SPK-02 question 5, Platform/SRE (ingress) + backend dev] — RECONNECT WITH Last-Event-ID TO A DIFFERENT API REPLICA restores the current snapshot. The evidence must show the two connections were served by DIFFERENT PODS: a reconnect that happens to land on the same replica proves nothing and is the way this criterion gets reported passed without being tested. Production runs three replicas scaling to six. The design answers this by reading committed state rather than by affinity, and **NO STICKY-SESSION OR SESSION-AFFINITY SETTING MAY BE INTRODUCED TO MAKE IT PASS** — story 10.18b introduced none, and the streaming Ingress it added carries no affinity annotation of any kind. Trading a design property for a deployment workaround would close this criterion by defeating the thing it exists to check.

cases.title: AC-16b [ED-06, SPK-02 questions 1-2, Platform/SRE (ingress) + frontend dev] — THE PLATFORM’S ACTUAL BROWSER-AUTH ROUTE, IN WRITING, COVERING FEDERATED MODE: which route carries the session cookie to the events and video paths — same-origin gateway path, or cross-origin with withCredentials plus exact-origin credentialed CORS — and whether it holds in BOTH standalone and federated (shell-hosted) modes, where the browser’s origin is the PUT platform shell’s and no values file in this chart can know it; and whether a bearer-only requirement exists anywhere on the path, in which case SSE needs the header-capable client inside the centralized API service (STORY 10.11’s, not this one’s) and <video> needs an ambient session regardless.
